title: Fleeting Inspiration
body:
On his This is It tour, Michael Jackson was asked by his director Kenny Ortega to tone down the constant additions to his set and production. 

Michael said "God channels this through me at night. I can't sleep because I'm so supercharged" 

Ortega jokingly replied: "Can't God take a vacation?"

To which Michael said: "You don't understand -- if I'm not there to receive these ideas, God might give them to Prince."

This idea wasn't held by MJ alone. Rick Rubin writes in The Creative Act: "If you have an idea you're excited about and you don't bring it it's not uncommon for the idea to find it's voice through another maker. This isn't because the other artist stole your idea, but because the idea's time has come."

When inspiration comes, it must be acted upon immediately, lest it find it's place in the mind of another.

title: Tastemakers
body: There are certain people in this life that are known as "tastemakers." These people set the tone for what is considered "good" and what is considered "bad." However to these people good and bad is just what they like and what they don't like.
